newsitem.title: USA: Iomega sues Syquest over patent.
newsitem.headline: Iomega sues Syquest over patent.

text.p: Iomega Corp said on Tuesday it has filed a complaint in U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware, accusing SyQuest Technology Inc of infringing upon Iomega's patents and trademarks.
In the complaint, Iomega contends that SyQuest is selling products, without authorization, which embody patented inventions that are the property of Iomega.
The complaint alleges infringement of two Iomega patents, one covering Iomega's Read/Write Protection Scheme and the other covering the design of Iomega's Jaz cartridge, Iomega said in a statement.
The suit also seeks to prevent SyQuest from using Iomega's JET trademarks, which are used to identify Iomega's data storage devices, Iomega said.
Iomega is seeking injunctions to prevent SyQuest's continuing infringement of Iomega's patents and trademarks, as well as monetary damages, it said.
Syquest was not immediately available for comment.
